name: email-assistant
description: Personalized email and meeting assistance, requested connected-app actions, and evidence-based Wrike completion with user-owned rules and cloud scheduling.

interface.longDescription: Ten skills coordinate inbox drafts and archiving, Pocket meeting reports and Outlook follow-up drafts, Wrike task capture and completion checks, and directly requested email sends, unsubscribe, calendar, Teams and SharePoint actions. Scheduled email remains draft-only. User-owned rules and progress live in Spaces. Connected write capabilities and a verified client cloud pilot are required.
capabilities: Create or edit SharePoint documents on request
defaultPrompt: Help me set up and manage my daily email assistant.
Update my inbox rules and show what will change.
Show drafts, follow-ups, and meeting outcomes that need my attention.
